basis: The pricing-feed rows anchored on https://kie.ai/ltx-2-5?model=ltx%2F2-5-fast-audio-to-video and the live GET /api/v1/models pricingDesc agree: 10.8 / 15.6 / 22.8 credits (0.054 / 0.078 / 0.114 USD) per second at 720p / 1080p / 1440p, 'billed on the actual video length (follows your audio, to 0.01 s)'. Both match the survey's 2026-11-19 reads (ac-51w0vl). The billed seconds are the request's duration when set (2-20, cut from the start of the audio), else the audio's length cut to the limit (20 s, or 10 s at 1440p or at 48 or 50 fps). The recording below set duration 2 on a 6.008 s audio: the output was 2.000 s and billed 21.6 credits = 2.00 x 10.8, charged at success. The docs page re-read on 2026-11-20 differs from the survey's copy (sha256 ec1382e4...) only in removed x-apidog field-order metadata.

entry.title: LTX 2.5 Fast Audio to Video
entry.description: LTX 2.5 Fast Audio to Video API on Kie.ai: generate lip-synced speech, singing and beat-matched 720p to 1440p MP4 video driven by your uploaded audio.
entry.pricingDesc:
LTX 2.5 Fast Audio to Video: 10.8 / 15.6 / 22.8 credits ($0.054 / $0.078 / $0.114) per second at 720p / 1080p / 1440p, billed on the actual video length (follows your audio, to 0.01 s) — 40% below official LTX-2.5 Fast pricing.

High-tier top-ups come with bonus credits that lower the effective price by about 10%.
